data.name: Engedus
data.long_meaning: Engedus is derived from the Greek word 'engedus' which means 'deep' or 'sublime'. This name was given to a place near the Red Sea where Moses and the Israelites stopped during their Exodus from Egypt (Exodus 15:4).
